entities.summary: Sesil Radoslavova Karatantcheva is a Bulgarian inactive professional tennis player. On 7 November 2005, she reached her best singles ranking of world No. 35. On 19 April 2010, she peaked at No. 154 in the doubles rankings. In her career, she won nine singles titles on the ITF Women's Circuit.
